assessment: Known security/correctness defects prompted a targeted dependency update; bounded old/fixed regression and actual locked-dependency CI regression passed. Full rebuilt artifact qualification is separate.

advisory.finding: A peer-controlled IdList count was allocated before message-length validation. The maintainer explicitly tied yanking prior versions to the security fix.

upstream_changes.change: Validate ID count against bytes remaining before reserving memory.
Fingerprint from the last emitted range boundary after a frame-size cut so reconciliation does not silently omit differences.

compatibility.requirement: nostr-relay-pool 0.44.3 requests negentropy ^0.5 with std explicitly enabled.

private_old_fixed_regression.method: GlobalAlloc checks alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc before System. Oversized requests use stack-only reporting then _exit(86); no real OOM is attempted. Actual cached 0.5.1 and 0.5.3 are exercised with std in both roles.
private_old_fixed_regression.prior_runner_nonpass: Initial runner incorrectly expected the exact upstream allocation byte count; this platform requested 8 bytes less. The guard correctly exited 86. Only the runner assertion changed to require a blocked request above the bound; the same binary was reused.

reference_transport_reachability.finding: Inspected reference transports use Client.fetch_events/send_event and keep Client private. No product NIP-77 sync or Negentropy call was found; the upstream parser is inside explicit relay sync processing of peer NEG-MSG.
limits: Static trace does not prove unreachability for every downstream use.
No current reference-app remote exploitability is asserted from dependency presence alone.
Core/WASM protocol-only nostr dependency is distinct from nostr-sdk/relay-pool; workspace lock membership is not a linked-binary inventory.

qualification_limits: No real relay/account traffic, actual OOM or unbounded allocation attempted.
Only a standalone security fixture/runner and CI step were added by this lane; no production manifest, lock or native compile-input changes.
The frame-cut completeness fix was inspected upstream but not independently executed by this malformed-input harness.
Previous successful 0.5.1 consumer tests do not negate the advisory; new app/package evidence must identify the patched closure.

repository_ci_regression.selection: cargo metadata --locked --offline resolves the actual workspace dependency. An isolated temporary package path-depends on that exact source with std; no hardcoded package version or shared Cargo target.
repository_ci_regression.ci_position: Portable job immediately after locked fetch and complete dependency-license inventory.

version_delta.workspace_manifest: workspace package version and booknook-core workspace dependency version 0.1.1

final_0_1_1_lock_observation.scope: Local isolated regression against final 0.1.1 workspace lock. Earlier repository_ci_regression result remains the historical pre-version-bump fixed-lock observation; this is not hosted CI or rebuilt package qualification.
